VADER for MPC OS 3.x (Akai Force / MPC): an orbit-based vector synth. Two zips: `VADER-<version>-mpc-sdk.zip` for MPC OS 3.10.1 or later (any MPC or Force, 32-bit and 64-bit, no mod: turn on External Plugin Support and copy the folder into `VST2 Plugins`, see INSTALL.txt), and `VADER-<version>-mpc-armv7.zip` for a modded MPC or Force (unzip, then follow INSTALL.md: root SSH access, e.g. MockbaMod).
Both hold the plugin with example shapes and samples. How to use it: [the user guide](https://github.com/sunskiefer/VADER/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md).
Tested on a device when listed in tested.json (a pre-release until then). See CHANGELOG.md for what changed.

**0.10.0** adds the 64-bit build for the newer MPCs (Live III, XL) and the zip in Akai's plugin format; the sound, pages, PLUG (the desktop plugin as the MPC's screen) and the companion screen are 0.9.2's. It has not been tried on a device yet (0.9.1 was tried on the Force). PolyForm Noncommercial license. The desktop plugins (VST3 and VST2 for Windows and Linux) are in the `desktop-0.10.0` release.
